snippet.title: LUMINOVA - Official Launch Trailer | Xbox & PC
snippet.description:
Test your reflexes in this minimalist 2.5D precision auto-runner! Control a high-speed white cube, master the wall jump to change direction, and collect 3 energy fragments to unlock the exit portal. With intuitive one-button controls and 30 handcrafted levels, your rhythm dictates your survival.

🗓️ Release Date: November 27
🎮 Platforms: Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Windows PC (Xbox Play Anywhere)
🛒 Get it on Xbox Store: https://www.xbox.com/pt-BR/games/store/luminova/9NWX7C43VXFH

Key Features:
 * Pure one-button controls focused entirely on timing.
 * Reactive Wall Jump mechanics for rapid directional changes.
 * 30 hardcore levels with a razor-thin margin for error.
 * Clean, minimalist 2.5D aesthetics.

Follow for updates:
Instagram: @renanartdev
